title: A baby construction of surreal numbers in Lean 4. This is part of an undergraduate independent study project in Fall 2025.

source.citation: J.H. Conway, On Numbers and Games, 2nd ed., A K Peters 2001; D. Schleicher, M. Stoll, An Introduction to Conway's Games and Numbers, Moscow Math. J. 6 (2006) 359-388 (arXiv math/0410026)
source.scope: addition, multiplication, ordered ring structure of (short) surreal numbers
source.evidence: README references: '1. John H. Conway, On Numbers and Games ... 2. Dierk Schleicher and Michael Stoll, An Introduction to Conway's Games and Numbers' (local copies in repo); blueprint follows its own Lean proof path, no \cite.

edge_sample.source_text: theorem Negation reverses order: For all games \(a,b\), \[ a\preceq b\Longleftrightarrow -b\preceq-a, \qquad a\prec b\Longleftrightarrow -b\prec-a, \qquad a\sim b\Longleftrightarrow -b\sim-a. \]
edge_sample.target_text: definition Short surreal numbers: The type \(\mathbf{No}_{\mathrm{short}}\) is the quotient of surreal representatives by \(a\sim b\). Addition, zero, one, and negation descend to this quotient.
